state.task:
Question-answering task using the company document service.

The company handbook is held by a document service; it is not available as files. Documents
have a header line (version, status, effective dates, what they supersede) and numbered
sections; each section is a passage, cited as "HB-07 §2". Documents can have superseded
versions, and memos can add group exceptions and carve-outs. Use the rule that applies to the
situation and date in the question.

Service actions (reply with one of these instead of "execute"):
  {"action": "search", "query": "lodging limit Geneva", "k": 5, "thought": "..."}
      up to k (at most 8; default 5) ranked passages with ids and document headers. Each
      result is also saved under /task/workspace/search-results/ (path in the result header),
      where your code can read it later.
  {"action": "fetch", "ids": ["HB-07 §2", "HB-12"], "thought": "..."}
      the named passages in full; a document id ("HB-12") returns all its sections; at most
      10 ids per fetch.
You can still use "execute" for code (for example to read saved results or manage your
context), and "final" to answer.

Questions:
- Q1: What is the relocation lump sum for an employee relocating to another country at the company's request today? (answer in EUR)
- Q2: What is the purchase approval threshold for IT hardware bought by the facilities department today? (answer in EUR)
- Q3: What is the bike-leasing allowance for a regular employee leasing an e-bike with the insurance package today? (answer in EUR per month)
- Q4: What is the nightly lodging limit for a standard business trip today (2026-10-13)? (answer in EUR per night)
- Q5: What is the taxi allowance for a daytime business taxi ride with trade-fair luggage today? (answer in EUR per ride)
- Q6: What monthly mobile allowance applied to a regular employee using a private phone on 2026-05-15? (answer in EUR per month)

Finish with {"action": "final", "answer": {"answers": [{"question": "Q1", "value": "...",
"citations": ["HB-07 §2", ...]}, ...]}}. Give one entry per question. The value must be the
exact amount; citations must include every passage needed to support it (for example the rule
and any exception or carve-out that applies), not just one passage.
state.query: purchase approval threshold IT hardware bought by the facilities department
state.step_intent: Find the purchase approval threshold that applies to: What is the purchase approval threshold for IT hardware bought by the facilities department today?

passages.source: HB-65 §3 | Memo: purchase approval threshold exceptions — Carve-out | version: 1 · status: current · effective: 2025-01-01
passages.text: The exception above does not apply to IT hardware bought by the facilities department; they follow the standard purchase approval threshold in HB-32 §2. The procurement publishes worked examples of the purchase approval threshold on the intranet. The procurement reviews the purchase approval threshold once a year and announces changes in advance.

passages.source: HB-65 §2 | Memo: purchase approval threshold exceptions — Exception for the facilities department | version: 1 · status: current · effective: 2025-01-01
passages.text: For the facilities department, the purchase approval threshold is 11000 EUR instead of the standard amount. Each claim for the purchase approval threshold needs a receipt showing the date, the amount and the supplier. The procurement publishes worked examples of the purchase approval threshold on the intranet.

passages.source: HB-65 §1 | Memo: purchase approval threshold exceptions — Purpose | version: 1 · status: current · effective: 2025-01-01
passages.text: This memo lists group exceptions to the purchase approval threshold in HB-32. The procurement publishes worked examples of the purchase approval threshold on the intranet. Questions about the purchase approval threshold go to the procurement, who keeps the record of decisions.

passages.source: HB-32 §4 | Procurement policy: approvals — Exceptions | version: 3 · status: current · effective: 2026-05-01 · supersedes: HB-21
passages.text: Group exceptions to the purchase approval threshold are published in HB-65. Managers confirm claims for the purchase approval threshold before payment in the next payroll run. The procurement publishes worked examples of the purchase approval threshold on the intranet.

passages.source: HB-32 §1 | Procurement policy: approvals — Scope | version: 3 · status: current · effective: 2026-05-01 · supersedes: HB-21
passages.text: This policy sets the purchase approval threshold for all employees. The procurement reviews the purchase approval threshold once a year and announces changes in advance. Each claim for the purchase approval threshold needs a receipt showing the date, the amount and the supplier.
